title: Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish inspired by Syrian cuisine, perfect for grilling in the summer. This recipe combines the rich taste of lamb with the brightness of zesty flavors.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to handle and store the lamb safely

ingredients.name: Zesty olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality olive oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Granulated sugar
ingredients.notes: This will balance out the acidity of the zesty flavors

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the lamb, zesty olive oil, Syrian spices, salt, black pepper, and sugar until well combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
